title: The Only Male Teacher
description: Teaching at a sinister all-girls school was not what I expected.

parts.text: Part 1 of Episode 1: The gates of St. Jude's Academy were taller and more imposing than I had imagined. As I walked through, the heavy iron bars clanged shut behind me, sounding like a prison door. My parents were so proud of my scholarship, but they didn't see the coldness in the eyes of the guard at the entrance. Everyone here wore a mask—a porcelain-white face with a fixed, eerie smile. It was a rule, they said. 'To ensure equality among students.' But to me, it felt like they were hiding something sinister.

translations.hi:
यह कहानी शुरू [संगीत] होती है एक ऐसी जगह

से जहां जाना किसी भी लड़के का सपना हो

सकता है। लेकिन मेरे लिए वो एक अनसुलझी

पहेली बन गया। मैं एक लड़कियों [संगीत] के

स्कूल में इकलौता मेल टीचर हूं। जिस दिन

जॉइनिंग थी। पुराने टीचर ने काम सौंपते

वक्त बड़े अजीब [संगीत] ढंग से एक बात

कही। यह जगह जन्नत भी है और जहन्नुम भी।

इतना बोलकर वो शख्स जिसका नाम झांग वो था।

पीछे मुड़कर देखे बिना ही चला गया। मैं तो

वहीं खड़ा रह गया। दिमाग एकदम सुनना। सच

parts.text: Part 2 of Episode 1: I was assigned to Dorm 404. The hallways were silent, the only sound being the rhythmic ticking of a grandfather clock in the lobby. I met my roommate, a boy named Leo. He didn't take off his mask even in the room. 'Don't ever let them see your face,' he whispered, his voice trembling. 'If they do, you'll never leave this place.' I laughed it off as a prank, but that night, I heard a blood-curdling scream coming from the basement.

parts.text: Part 3 of Episode 1: Curiosity got the better of me. I slipped out of bed and followed the sound. The basement was dark, smelling of old paper and something metallic. I found a door slightly ajar. Inside, I saw a group of students standing in a circle, their masks glowing in a faint blue light. In the center was a student without a mask, his face frozen in a look of pure terror. Before I could see more, a hand grabbed my shoulder.

translations.hi:
पहुंचते ही [संगीत] मैडम चू ने मुझे पिछले

टीचर से हैंडओवर लेने भेज दिया। जब मैंने

पहली बार झांग बो को देखा तो मेरी हालत

[संगीत] खराब हो गई। वो बंदा हड्डियों का

ढांचा लग रहा था। पिचके हुए गाल, आंखों के

नीचे काले [संगीत] घेरे और होठों पर जैसे

गया [संगीत] कि उसने नौकरी क्यों छोड़ी या

तो उसे कोई जानलेवा बीमारी थी या फिर वो

parts.text: Part 4 of Episode 1: 'You shouldn't be here, Newbie.' It was a girl with a different mask—one with a tear painted on the cheek. Her name was Hana. She pulled me away and dragged me into a hidden corner. 'They are the 'Elected',' she explained. 'They are being processed. Once the mask is fused to their face, they lose their soul. We have to stop them before they find you.' I realized then that my scholarship wasn't an honor—it was a death sentence.

ही उखड़ा उखड़ा सा था। काम की बातों के

अलावा एक शब्द नहीं बोला। पर मुझे महसूस

हो रहा था कि उसकी वो धुंधली आंखें चोरी

छुपे मुझे ऊपर से नीचे [संगीत] तक नाप रही

थी। जातेजाते उसने मुझे जो नजरों से देखा

उसमें जलन भी थी और एक अजीब सी बेबसी भी।

parts.text: Part 5 of Episode 1: Hana told me about a resistance group called 'The Unmasked'. They were students who had managed to find a way to keep their identity secret. 'We meet at midnight in the old library,' she said. 'If you want to survive, be there.' I returned to my room, my heart pounding. As I looked in the mirror, my own smile felt like a mask. The sinister school had only just begun to reveal its secrets.

translations.hi:

पुरानी फाइल मिली। उसे देखकर मेरे होश उड़

[संगीत] कि उसकी जॉइनिंग सिर्फ एक महीने

पहले हुई थी। फाइल में लगी उसकी फोटो में

वो एकदम हट्टा कट्टा हीरो जैसा लग रहा था।

चौड़ा सीना, गजब के मसल्स और चेहरे पर एक

[संगीत] तगड़ी चमक। अगर अपनी आंखों से

parts.text: Part 1 of Episode 2: The next morning, the school routine seemed normal, but I couldn't unsee what I saw in the basement. Every teacher spoke in a monotone voice, and every student moved with robotic precision. During history class, I noticed that all the textbooks had missing pages. Any mention of the school's founding was erased. I looked at Hana across the room; she gave me a subtle nod. She was watching the 'Shadow Guards'—students who acted as the school's secret police.

translations.hi:
कि यह वही कंकाल [संगीत] जैसा आदमी है जो

अभी यहां से गया है। मेरा माथा ठंका।

सिर्फ एक महीने में ऐसा क्या हुआ कि उसकी

यह हालत हो गई। उसने जो जन्नत [संगीत] और

जहन्नुम वाली बात कही थी। उसका मतलब क्या

था? अभी मैं सोच ही रहा था कि मैडम चैन शू

अंदर आ गई। उन्होंने मेरा हाथ पकड़ कर

खींचते हुए कहा। चलिए 12वीं क्लास की

लड़कियां आपका [संगीत] इंतजार कर रही है।

की थी और उनकी फिट बॉडी देखकर कोई भी जवान

parts.text: Part 2 of Episode 2: After class, a Shadow Guard approached me. 'Your mask is loose, student,' he said, his voice echoing from behind his porcelain face. He reached out to tighten it, and I felt a sharp needle-like sting on my neck. I realized he was trying to inject me with something. I pushed him away and ran. I didn't stop until I reached the library. The smell of old books was the only thing that felt real in this fake world.

translations.hi:
लड़का [संगीत] पानी भर दे। मुझ जैसे कम

एक्सपीरियंस वाले बंदे के लिए उनका इतना

करीब आना संभालना मुश्किल हो रहा था। मैडम

हंसते हुए बोली शर्माओ मत अब इसी माहौल

में रहना है। रास्ते में उन्होंने बताया

कि यह मेड [संगीत] हाई स्कूल एक चैरिटी

स्कूल है जहां अनाथ या गरीब घर की

लड़कियां पढ़ती है। यहां का सारा खर्चा एक

फाउंडेशन उठाता है। सुनकर अच्छा लगा कि

दुनिया में अब भी कुछ [संगीत] लोग

निस्वार्थ सेवा कर रहे हैं। पर एक अजीब

parts.text: Part 3 of Episode 2: I found the secret entrance behind a shelf of ancient law books. Hana and three other students were there. They had a map of the school's underground network. 'The Headmaster is not a person,' one of them, a boy named Jax, said. 'He's an AI controlled by an organization called 'The Architect'. They are using us to train a hive-mind.' I couldn't believe it. My school was a laboratory.

translations.hi:
नियम यह था कि यह एक पूरी तरह से क्लोज

स्कूल है। छुट्टियों के अलावा कोई बाहर

नहीं जा सकता। दीवारें इतनी ऊंची और उन पर

कटीलेदार। हर कोने में कैमरे [संगीत] और

महिला गार्ड्स। यह स्कूल कम और जेल ज्यादा

लग रहा था। मैंने डरते डरते पूछा मैडम अगर

कोई भागने की कोशिश करे तो क्या सजा मिलती

है? चयू एकदम चुप हो गई। उनकी आंखों में

पल भर के लिए एक गहरा खौफ दिखा। उन्होंने

बस इतना कहा बेहतर होगा कि तुम कभी नियम

parts.text: Part 4 of Episode 2: We planned to infiltrate the server room in the North Tower. That's where the control signals for the masks were sent from. But to get there, we had to pass through the 'Hall of Mirrors'. It was a psychological trap designed to break anyone who dared to question the school's authority. Hana looked at me. 'Are you ready? There's no turning back.' I nodded. I had to find a way out, for my parents and for myself.

translations.hi:
का दरवाजा खोला। मैं दंग रह गया। अंदर

दर्जनों लड़कियां वार्म [संगीत] अप कर रही

थी। शॉट्स और टीशर्ट में उनकी चमकती हुई

स्किन और खिलखिलाहट ने मेरा दम सा [संगीत]

अटका दिया। मैडम ने मेरा इंट्रोडक्शन

कराया। यह है आपके नए पीटी टीचर मिस्टर

फंगोई। सबकी निगाहें मुझ पर टिक गई।

नमस्ते सर। वेलकम सर। उनकी मीठी आवाजें

और हकलाते हुए बोला, हेलो स्टूडेंट्स, सब

लड़कियां मुंह [संगीत] पर हाथ रखकर हंसने

parts.text: Part 5 of Episode 2: We moved through the shadows of the North Tower. The Hall of Mirrors was ahead. As we stepped in, the reflections started talking to us, pointing out our deepest fears and failures. 'You're not good enough,' my reflection whispered. 'You'll end up like your brother.' My brother... he had gone missing three years ago. Was he here too? I felt a surge of anger and used it to shatter the first mirror. The illusion broke, but the alarm started ringing.

parts.text: Part 1 of Episode 3: The North Tower was suddenly flooded with light. Shadow Guards were coming from every direction. 'Run!' Jax shouted. We scrambled through the narrow vents, the sound of boots echoing below us. I could hear my own breathing, loud and ragged. We reached a dead end, but Hana pulled a lever, and a hidden door opened into a long-forgotten laboratory. It was filled with deactivated masks and old computers.

है। पर यहां तो पूरी की [संगीत] पूरी

parts.text: Part 2 of Episode 3: I saw a photo on a desk. It was my brother, smiling without a mask. The caption read: 'Subject 001 - Failure'. My heart sank. He had been the first one. I realized that my scholarship wasn't random; they wanted to see if the 'failure' was genetic. I felt a cold fury rising within me. I wasn't going to be another 'subject'. I was going to be their downfall.

translations.hi:
ढूंढना भी तो कोई आसान काम नहीं है। खैर,

अभी मैं ज्यादा सोच पाता, उससे पहले ही

थ्री लेग रेस खिलाने का फैसला किया। यह

गेम टीम और [संगीत] बैलेंस के लिए बेस्ट

parts.text: Part 3 of Episode 3: We found a terminal that was still active. Jax started hacking into the system. 'I can see the mask blueprints!' he exclaimed. 'There's a kill-switch.' But to activate it, we needed a master key that only the Headmaster possessed. The Headmaster's office was at the top of the tower, guarded by the 'Shadow Elite'—the most powerful masked students in the school.

translations.hi:
हूं। मेरा नाम हंगजिंग है। उसका चेहरा

गोलमटोल और बड़ा मासूम था। पर उसकी बॉडी

भाई किसी बॉलीवुड एक्ट्रेस को फेल कर दे।

parts.text: Part 4 of Episode 3: We split up. Hana and Jax stayed to download the data, while I and a student named Mia went to the top floor. The Shadow Elite were waiting for us. They didn't move like humans; they moved like ghosts. One of them attacked Mia, and I had to use a heavy fire extinguisher to knock him back. We were outnumbered and outmatched, but we had the element of surprise.

translations.hi:
उन्हें बांध दिया। वो एकदम मुझसे चिपक कर

खड़ी थी और उसके चेहरे पर एक अजीब सी जीत

वाली मुस्कान थी। वही दूसरी [संगीत]

लड़कियां उसे ऐसे देख रही थी जैसे वो उसकी

जान ले लेंगी। उनकी आंखों में जलन साफ दिख

रही थी। अब देखो मैं कोई रतिक रोशन तो हूं

जाए। पर उस वक्त वो सब जिस तरह मुझे देख

रही थी। मेरा कॉन्फिडेंस सातवें आसमान पर

पहुंच गया। मैं उसे तकनीक समझाते हुए

parts.text: Part 5 of Episode 3: We reached the Headmaster's office. The door was made of solid titanium. I used the explosives Jax had given me to blow it open. Inside, there was no one. Just a massive holographic projection of a man's face. 'Welcome, Subject 002,' the Headmaster said. 'I've been waiting for you to complete the cycle.' He didn't sound like an AI; he sounded like... my father.
